input: Research coliving spaces abroad for a workation

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The destination region dramatically changes which spaces are available, relevant visa rules, time zones, and cost levels — a Southeast Asia search looks completely different from a European one.
A 2-week workation vs. a 3-month stay affects whether to look at short-term bookings, monthly memberships, or long-stay contracts, and changes pricing tiers significantly.
Coliving prices range from ~$500/month in cheap destinations to $4,000+/month in Western Europe — the budget cap filters out most options immediately.
A solo traveler, a couple, or a small team each need different room configurations, shared-space policies, and may have different community-fit priorities.
Some people just need reliable Wi-Fi; others need a dedicated desk, a private office, video-call booths, or access to co-working facilities — this is a hard filter for many spaces.
Some coliving spaces emphasise social events, networking, and communal meals; others are quieter and more independent — the vibe fit determines shortlist criteria.

keyUnknowns.axis: success criteria / output of the research
keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether the user wants a comparison spreadsheet, a shortlist of 3-5 top picks, or a ready-to-book recommendation changes the depth and format of the research task entirely.

gold.taskTitle: Research coliving spaces abroad for a workation
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate coliving spaces in a foreign location that support remote work, balancing community living with professional productivity.

questions.title: Which region or country are you targeting for this workation?
questions.description: Identify the destination — e.g., Southeast Asia, Southern Europe, Latin America, or a specific country — to scope the search geographically.

questions.title: How long do you plan to stay at the coliving space?
questions.description: Determine the intended duration — days, weeks, or months — to match the right booking type and pricing tier.

questions.title: What is your total monthly budget for accommodation?
questions.description: Establish a clear budget ceiling to filter out spaces that are out of range and focus on realistic options.

questions.title: Will you be going solo, with a partner, or with a team?
questions.description: Clarify who is travelling to determine room type needs, shared-space dynamics, and whether group booking options matter.

questions.title: What are your non-negotiable work setup requirements?
questions.description: Identify hard requirements such as guaranteed upload/download speeds, private desks, video-call booths, or access to a separate co-working space.

questions.title: Do you prefer a social buzzing community or a quieter independent atmosphere?
questions.description: Gauge lifestyle fit — whether the user wants organised events, communal meals, and networking, or a more low-key, self-directed environment.

questions.title: What should the final output of this research look like?
questions.description: Define the deliverable — e.g., a shortlist of top picks, a side-by-side comparison, links with notes, or a fully ready booking recommendation.
questions.coversAxis: success criteria / output of the research
